title: SassaGrantHub Search Intent Map
description: Mapping of beneficiary search intents to single canonical destinations, ensuring zero internal keyword cannibalization and protecting SEO equity.

mappings.intent: How to check my SASSA status online / USSD / WhatsApp
mappings.differentiatingFocus: Operational step-by-step instructions across all 4 official channels with direct official links and zero data-harvesting forms.

mappings.intent: What does my specific SASSA status mean?
mappings.pageType: Status Meaning Hub & Interactive Problem Solver
mappings.differentiatingFocus: Interactive diagnosis explaining what it means, what could cause it, what to check right now, and what to do next.

mappings.intent: SRD R370 grant details, application and payment dates
mappings.differentiatingFocus: All-in-one authoritative grant overview covering criteria, monthly vetting cycle, application jump-links, and historical R350 context.

mappings.intent: When will SASSA pay this month / upcoming months?
mappings.differentiatingFocus: Complete verified payment calendar for Older Persons, Disability, Child Support and SRD windows with monthly deep-dive subpages.

mappings.intent: How to appeal a declined SASSA grant within 90 days
mappings.differentiatingFocus: Statutory 90-day ITSAA tribunal submission guide with required evidence, affidavits, and document preparation.

mappings.intent: How to update SASSA banking details or switch to bank EFT
mappings.differentiatingFocus: Walkthrough of OTP security validation, 7-10 day PASANet clearance, and third-party account prohibitions.

mappings.intent: Where is my local SASSA branch or service office?
mappings.differentiatingFocus: Provincial breakdown of verified physical addresses, contact lines, operating hours, and queue-beating recommendations.

mappings.intent: Download official SASSA forms, templates and checklists
mappings.differentiatingFocus: Direct downloads and completion walkthroughs for Form 001, Bank Consent, Sworn Affidavits, and document checklists.
